ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web shows a southern pygmy perch near the upper left. Arrows point into the southern pygmy perch from water flea, mayfly larvae, and freshwater shrimp, indicating these organisms are food for the perch. The question says the mayfly larvae and water flea are removed from the food web. Reasoning: If the perch loses two of its food sources, it will depend more on the remaining prey still connected to it. Since freshwater shrimp remains as a food source for the perch, the perch will eat more freshwater shrimp.
